title: The Young and the Restless Spoilers Thursday, July 30: Devon Admits to Lily his Money Changed Him; Daniel Offers Abby Friendly Support; Phyllis Helps Matt Remove his Ankle Monitor; Noah's Jealous Matt Could Steal Sienna - NewsBreak
text:
By CP Bialois ,
5 hours ago The Young and the Restless spoilers for Thursday, July 30 reveal Devon Winters ( Bryton James ) admits to Lily Winters ( Christel Khalil ) he doesn’t know who him money changed him into, meanwhile Daniel Romalotti ( Michael Graziadei ) offers Abby Newman ( Melissa Ordway ) friendly support and asks her to join him on a not-date
Phyllis Summers ( Michelle Stafford ) helps Matt Clark ( Roger Howarth ) remove his ankle monitor and Noah Newman ( Lucas Adams ) wants to force Matt out of time so he can keep Sienna Bacall ( Tamara Braun ).
Key Highlights: Devon blames his money for being a jerk. Daniel offers friendly support to Abby. Phyllis removes Matt’s ankle monitor. Noah is afraid of losing Sienna to Matt
Be like Cane The Young and the Restless spoilers suggest Devon finally understands he’s the problem. He doesn’t know why, but he’s trying to work through it. He’ll pay Lily a surprise visit and after a tense moment from Cane Ashby ( Billy Flynn ) being there, he’ll admit he doesn’t know what kind of man his money is making him into.
To be fair, he was turning into what he currently is for a while now, but it wasn’t because of the money. He wants to emulate Victor Newman ( Eric Braeden )’s way of protecting his family. So, he tries to bully everyone, but they’re trying to each him before he goes too fa.
It’ll be a good moment for him at least admitting he’s the problem and looking to make it right. Funny enough, he’s following Dumas and Cane’s storyline. Nothing like recycling something that’s still fresh.
There could be another issue he’ll have to deal with soon, and that’s Daniel and Abby’s growing friendship. It’s still early and Daniel isn’t trying to break them up, but inviting Abby to hear a new singer sounds like a date. If Devon catches wind of it, things will get interesting.
JPI Studios Noah’s jealous and Matt breaks free Well, it looks like Noah is going to be more intent on making Matt leave Genoa City whether he wants to or not. At first, his reasoning was the same as his father’s, but that’s changed. After Sienna talked about seeing the man she loved in him and it bringing back good memories, Noah will redouble his efforts.
It looks like he doesn’t like competition, and with Sienna getting misty eyed he’s going to want to remove any obstacle he can to remain happy. Of course, he’s too self absorbed to pay attention to what’s happening. A bar or club are perfect places to gather information since people talk, so we’re thinking he doesn’t know Matt and Phyllis are an item now.
Speaking of the new lovebirds, Phyllis will successfully cut off Matt’s ankle monitor and joke that he should put it in the stables. That would be an interesting sight to see, but for now, he’ll do what he can to lose Victor’s guards so he can breathe a little.
Will Matt leave or stick around? Let us know in the comments below.
